Sidney Curtis is the ultimate professional with integrity and care for the project and for customers.  The roofing crew was outstanding in their consistent cleanup all during the job and meticulous cleanup at the job's finish.  The crew chief, Gasper, was pleasant, communicative and professional.  They all deserve an A+ rating!

reviews.text: Sydney was very thorough and professional while explaining the cost and procedures of my roof repairs. He coordinated with the gutter repairman that I had previously  retained   In addition to the window people and leaf guard people. He handled all insurance needs appropriately.   His crew was respectful and worked diligently to put my new roof on in two days. His foreman was excellent at communication. Ive had 2 roofs put on prior to this one. We built the house 30 + years and this was the first time I have had the choice of color for the shingles. It really changed the exterior of my home and I love it. I would highly recommend hiring Verified Roofing.
reviews.author: Peggy Smith

reviews.text: All of the folks at Verified Roofing were outstanding! The professionalism and going above and beyond dealing with our insurance company, scheduling and timely completion was truly helpful in keeping our stress level low. Each sub-contractor they brought in were very professional and answered all questions as they performed their part of the overall project. I can't go without saying the roofing crew were courteous, professional, kept the sight picked up and cleaned each day.
reviews.author: Clay Francell

reviews.text: Verified Roofing handled all of the interactions with my insurance company professionally and effectively. I also appreciated the roofing options presented by Verified. I decided to go with Class IV hail resistant shingles. Subcontractors for roof replacement and for gutter replacement did a superior job. I really appreciated the direct oversight that Verified provided throughout the process. Cleanup was thorough. Verified was an excellent choice for my roof and gutter replacement. One thing that I especially appreciate is their honest and thorough  inspection prior to settling the claim. Needless to say, I will be calling Verified in the future if the need arises.
reviews.author: John Babb

reviews.text: We highly recommend Sidney and team at Verified Roofing. We are so thankful for their support. The entire team of experts is courteous and friendly.   Sidney and his office crew worked tirelessly over months with our home insurer to secure adequate coverage for replacing our hail-damaged roof with a new hail/wind resistant and warranted shingle solution. His install crew- Gaspar, Israel and many others-- was extremely skilled and very productive, working thru the July-in-Texas heat.  The crew protected the landscape and kept our property tidy.  Sidney also coordinated the skilled subcontractors (gutters, Chimney work) to finish out the installation.
reviews.author: Becky Brown

reviews.text: Verified roofing has been my go to for several years now. They’re always professional and reasonable. Recently, a tree fell on my house and they were quick to come out and help me get repairs done.
reviews.author: Taylor Bell

reviews.text:
I was in need of a new roof, Sydney was excellent and very knowledgeable, he spent hours on the roof documenting everything for the insurance company prior to him having a contract. They stripped it to wood, replaced and painted the many rotten facia boards and a couple deck boards, all the drip edges, flashings around the fireplace, skylights and anywhere else brick met wood. Moved a couple incorrectly installed vents, added bathroom vents, and removed the turbine vents and installed ridge vents.
Despite some challenges they were in and out in 2 days and the yard was nearly spotless when they left, Michaele was wonderful and we are more than happy with the results.
Also had the house wrapped in black gutters, those were installed a couple days later, I think they look great against the black farmed tinted windows.
Very interested to see how the new Hail resistant shingles hold up here in Texas :)
reviews.author: RG-Bandit

reviews.text: Definitely a five star company and team.  Every team member I worked with was professional, responsive and very helpful!  Was impressed with workmanship and quality care.
reviews.author: Patrick Rosso
